tools.name: x64dbg
tools.purpose: Dynamic debugger for tracing memory accesses at the assembly level -- finds the exact instructions that read/write game state values, enabling struct base discovery from a single confirmed offset
tools.launcher_notes: x96dbg.exe is the bitness-aware launcher: for -p PID it inspects the target (IsWow64Process) and starts x32\x32dbg.exe for 32-bit (WOW64) processes or x64\x64dbg.exe for 64-bit ones (verified in x64dbg_launcher.cpp loadPid). The game is x86, so pre-arm-debugger.ps1 launches via x96dbg.exe and the debugger window that opens is x32dbg.
tools.approved_scope: Dynamic memory instruction tracing during positively verified offline replay sessions only
tools.platform_notes: Target game is x86 (WOW64-observed 32-bit); use release\x96dbg.exe so the launcher selects the x32 build for the game process.
tools.install_instructions: Snapshot zip snapshot_2026-05-27_12-11.zip from GitHub releases, extracted to C:\work\tools\x64dbg\, launcher release\x96dbg.exe (bitness-aware; x32\x32dbg.exe and x64\x64dbg.exe ship alongside)

tools.name: System Informer

tools.install_instructions: Installed 2026-08-04 via WinGet: winget install --id=WinsiderSS.SystemInformer -e (admin; installs to C:\Program Files\SystemInformer, not the pre-registered C:\tools\SystemInformer path). Launcher SystemInformer.exe + x86/ build for the x86 game.

tools.name: ReClass.NET
tools.release_name: v1.2 (2019-04-15; last published GitHub release -- dev continues on master/UnsafeMemoryScanner with newer nightlies distributed via reclass.net)
tools.purpose: Runtime class-layout reconstruction from staged survivor pointers -- attaches to the live game (x86 target; WOW64-observed like the scanner), pointer-chases a staged survivor into its object, and visualizes the surrounding struct fields (HP, position, yaw) so dynamic evidence becomes a concrete layout that feeds offline root verification
tools.launcher_notes: The root launcher (x86 PE) auto-selects the x86\ReClass.NET.exe or x64\ReClass.NET.exe build for the attached target; the x86 build is used for the 32-bit game process. Verified in the archive layout and by a live launch smoke test (launcher handed off to the app and kept a ReClass.NET window open).
tools.approved_scope: Runtime class-layout reconstruction from staged survivor pointers during positively verified offline replay sessions only

verification.notes: Installed 2026-08-04 from the canonical v1.2 GitHub release asset (ReClass.NET.rar, 2,748,658 bytes, sha256 verified against the registry). x86\ReClass.NET.exe and x64\ReClass.NET.exe both present (FileVersion 1.2.0.0); ReClass.NET_Launcher.exe launch smoke test started the app and kept the window open.

tools.platform_notes: Target game is x86 (WOW64-observed 32-bit; the scanner's GuardedMemoryReader resolves ImageFileMachineI386 with 32-bit pointers). ReClass.NET v1.2 ships x86 and x64 attach support; use the x86 process tree when attaching to wotblitz.exe.
tools.install_instructions: Download ReClass.NET.rar (2,748,658 bytes) from GitHub releases v1.2, extract to C:\tools\ReClass.NET\ (Windows bsdtar reads RAR natively), run ReClass.NET_Launcher.exe which selects the correct x86/x64 build for the attached target. SHA-256 above is the verified hash of the canonical v1.2 release asset. Newer nightly builds exist on reclass.net but are not pinned.

tools.name: PSScriptAnalyzer
tools.purpose: PowerShell static-analysis linter and repo script-hygiene gate -- catches PS 5.1-incompatible static members ([double]::IsFinite), PS7-only operators (??, &&, ||), assignment to automatic variables (the $Pid bug class), and unused variables/params across every tracked .ps1, run by scripts/invoke-scriptanalyzer.ps1 inside the validate gate
tools.launcher_notes: Dev-time module only -- never shipped, never loaded by product code. Module manifest declares PowerShellVersion 5.1; verified to import and run (75 rules) under both Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7. Import must be invoked via a script file (powershell -File), not inline -Command, which hangs on this machine (PSSA-import-hang gotcha).
tools.approved_scope: Dev-time static analysis of repository PowerShell scripts in the validate gate only; never downloaded or executed at application runtime
tools.platform_notes: Windows PowerShell 5.1 + PowerShell 7 on win32/win64; PowerShell 7 only on linux/macos. The repo's OD workflow host is Windows PowerShell 5.1 (5.1.26100), so 5.1 compatibility is the hard requirement (verified).
tools.install_instructions: Run scripts/install-psscriptanalyzer.ps1 (repo-root relative). It downloads the pinned nupkg from the PSGallery canonical URL to tools/external/downloads/, verifies SHA-256 against this entry, extracts to tools/external/installed/psscriptanalyzer/<version>/, and runs an import smoke test on both hosts.

tools.name: wotbreplay-inspector
tools.release_name: Local build of eigenein/wotbreplay-inspector @ 7659570b (2026-08-04 local snapshot)
tools.purpose: Independent replay-decode oracle: decodes battle_results.dat (typed + schema-less --raw protobuf walk) and data.wotreplay packet streams from a completely separate codebase (Rust + wotbreplay-parser), so the C# Replays adapter can be cross-validated against a second implementation. Run by scripts/invoke-replay-crosscheck.ps1.
tools.launcher_notes: Dev-time oracle only -- never shipped, never loaded by product code. Built from the local snapshot C:/work/wotbreplay-inspector-main (cargo build, stable toolchain, debug profile) against a locally patched copy of wotbreplay-parser (C:/work/tools/wotbreplay-parser-main): the EntityMethod match now accepts subtype 48 (updateArena2 on 11.18/11.19 replays) in addition to upstream subtype 47, with the same wire layout (subtype at offset 4, inner length u32, varint field number, quirky-length protobuf). Cargo lives under ~/.cargo/bin; the binary is staged as a pinned artifact. No Rust at runtime -- the repo's no-Rust-dependency rule is unchanged.
tools.approved_scope: Offline cross-validation of replay decoding only (scripts/invoke-replay-crosscheck.ps1); never downloaded or executed at application runtime
tools.platform_notes: Built as a win64 console exe on this machine. The target replay format is platform-independent (ZIP + pickle + protobuf).
tools.install_instructions: Binary staged at tools/external/installed/wotbreplay-inspector/wotbreplay-inspector.exe (hash-pinned above). Rebuild from the local snapshot if needed: cd C:/work/wotbreplay-inspector-main && cargo build, then copy target/debug/wotbreplay-inspector.exe and update the sha256 in this entry.

tools.name: wotbreplay-parser
tools.purpose: Schema reference + golden-vector corpus: documents the battle_results protobuf tag mappings (author stats, per-player credits/XP/damage/mm_rating/tank_id) the C# BattleResultsReader does not yet map, documents the pickle quirky-length framing (00 <len> FF for payloads >254 bytes), and ships real replay fixtures with published expected values used as golden vectors by scripts/invoke-replay-crosscheck.ps1.
tools.installed_path: C:/work/tools/wotbreplay-parser-main (source snapshot; not a repo dependency)
tools.launcher_notes: Source-only reference. The compiled binary that embeds it is the wotbreplay-inspector entry above. Its replays/ fixtures are 9.4-10.1 era -- older than the C# decoder's 11.18/11.19 version gate -- so golden vectors validate the Rust oracle itself, not the C# decoder (cross-checks must use 11.18/11.19 replays). Locally patched for 11.18/11.19: the EntityMethod match accepts subtype 48 (updateArena2) in addition to upstream subtype 47, so the typed UpdateArena roster surface is available on modern replays (see the inspector entry).
tools.approved_scope: Offline schema reference and golden-vector corpus for replay decoding validation only; never executed at application runtime
tools.platform_notes: Pure Rust library; platform-independent. Only its source + replay fixtures are used, via the inspector binary.
tools.install_instructions: Source snapshot already staged at C:/work/tools/wotbreplay-parser-main. No build required -- the compiled oracle is the wotbreplay-inspector entry.
